about_the_game:
Build a small town showing its years of neglect after the apocalypse with the Doomsday Tiles Rural pack! PVGames is back with another massive set of 3D modeled assets to help you craft incredible parallax maps for your heroes to explore. Let your heroes wander between decrepit storefronts, over asphalt bridges that have partially crumbled away, through parking lots that have been taken over by grasses and bushes, and more with this pack! Each tile comes in multiple angles so you can perfectly place each tile to fit your vision. And with more than 6,500 images to choose from, you’re sure to be able to build all the abandoned towns and forgotten small cities your game needs.

Want to add a few more buildings and warehouses to your maps but don’t need to spend ages getting them looking just right? Then use this pack’s 29 prebuilt building exteriors to make sure your towns don’t look too empty! 11 empty building interiors and 8 empty room interiors are also perfect when you want to add another room to a location but don’t need it to be a specific size or shape. Just add in all the furniture and debris the room needs, and you’re ready to go! If you’ve been wanting to create a vast destroyed world for your modern heroine to explore, then pick up the Doomsday Tiles Rural pack!


Contents:

* Buildings, both interior and exterior.
* All manner of barrels, trash bins, boxes, buckets, baskets, crates, and more.
* Barriers, fences, and barricades.
* Campers, bunkers, and other shelters.
* Post-apocalyptic playground items like slides, swings, monkey bars, and more.
* Interior décor such as beds, bathtubs, tables, chairs, sinks, cabinets, computers, fridges, ovens, and other furniture and appliances.
* Bicycles, boats, trains (and train tracks) and numerous destroyed vehicles (even destroyed airplanes).
* Numerous power lines and power poles, road signs.
* Books, bottles, lamps, tools, canned goods, survival bunker supplies, and tons of other items.
* Bridges, roads, and numerous ground types to mix and match.
* Foliage, trees, boulders, rocks, grass, leaves, and plants.
* Numerous amounts of debris, clutter, trash, and detritus to muck up your rural wasteland.
* Tiles to make motels, small shops, gas stations, and numerous types of houses and other building interiors and exteriors.
* And much more!

These tiles are fully compatible with all other PVGames tiles from the RPGTools line of assets. They go together especially well with the Doomsday assets.


Terms of Use:

This pack is for use in RPG Maker Series or the engine of your choice.
OK to be used in Commercial projects
Contents can be edited
OK for use in games with gore
OK for use in adult-rated games
